name: strategy-factory-r4-consolidation-freeze
purpose: Reduce the 500 already-confirmed R4 survivors to a manageable structurally diverse frozen shortlist without reading protected 2026.
representative_rule: Within each structural bucket choose the already-confirmed variant maximizing the minimum of 2024, 2025 full, 2025 H1 and 2025 H2 conditional edge; tie-break by lower BH q then larger 2025 selected sample.
protected_2026_policy: FORBIDDEN. This step may not read, inspect or summarize any 2026 market data. A separate committed preregistration and explicit owner approval are required before any protected 2026 evaluation.
scientific_interpretation: This is consolidation, not new independent evidence. Selection among confirmed variants is allowed only because a future untouched protected OOS remains mandatory. No candidate may be promoted from this step alone.
